Exercise 1 - examining the first CSV file
```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)

bird_breeding_sites <- read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
#Read csv file with breeding site location data

gt(bird_breeding_sites)
#Show csv file as a data frame

colnames(bird_breeding_sites)
#View column names

glimpse(bird_breeding_sites)
#View data frame summary

print(nrow(bird_breeding_sites))
#Print number of rows

print(ncol(bird_breeding_sites))
#Print number of columns

print(dim(bird_breeding_sites))
#Print both dimensions
```

Exercise 2 - read second CSV file
```{r}
bird_migration_sites <- read_csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
#Read csv file with migration data

gt(head(bird_migration_sites))
#Show top 10 rows of the file as a data frame

glimpse(bird_migration_sites)
#View summary

colnames(bird_migration_sites)
#View column name 
```

Selecting columns from bird breeding sites data
```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |> select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |> distinct() |> rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)

#Selecting only unique rows from the columns Site, Longitude and Latitude which have been renamed to be clearer
```

Selecting columns from bird migration sites data
```{r}
bird_migration_selected <- bird_migration_sites |>
  select(
    Site,
    winterLongitude,
    winterLatitude,
    pslon,
    pslat,
    iblon,
    iblat,
    awestlon,
    awestlat
  ) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(
    Winter_Longitude = winterLongitude,
    Winter_Latitude = winterLatitude,
    Stopover_Longitude = pslon,
    Stopover_Latitude = pslat,
    Iberian_Longitude = iblon,
    Iberian_Latitude = iblat,
    Westmost_Longitude = awestlon,
    Westmost_Latitude = awestlat
  )

gt(head(bird_migration_selected))

#Same as above for bird migration sites
```

Filtering data frames
```{r}
bird_breeding_exc <- bird_breeding_selected |>
  filter(Site != "Spain")
#Filter for all sites except Spain in breeding data
gt(bird_breeding_exc)

bird_migration_exc <- bird_migration_selected |>
  filter(Site != "Spain")
#Filter for all sites except Spain in migration data
gt(head(bird_migration_exc))
```

Grouping by site then calculating median values 
```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)
#Group by site
bird_migration_summary <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
#Calculate median values for each statistic, ignoring any NA values
gt(bird_migration_summary)
```

Joining data frames
```{r}
combined_bird_data <- full_join(bird_breeding_exc, bird_migration_summary)
#Combining data frames
gt(combined_bird_data)
```

Converting data frame to the long format
```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )
#Coverting wide data frame to long format
gt(combined_bird_piv)

```

Creating subsets of combined data frame and saving to output folder
```{r}
spring_vals <- c("Breeding", "Stopover", "Winter")
autumn_vals <- c("Breeding", "Iberian", "Westmost", "Winter")

spring_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% spring_vals)
#Creating spring data subset
autumn_data <- combined_bird_piv |>
  filter(Location_Type %in% autumn_vals)
#Creating autumn data subset
#Save subsets to output folder
write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")

```

Creating Figure 1B copy plot
```{r}
#Finding minimum and maximum latitudes and longitudes
min_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()
print(min_lon)

max_lon <- spring_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()
print(max_lon)

min_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()
print(min_lat)

max_lat <- spring_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()
print(max_lat)

#Creating a blank plot with axis labels
ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude)
)

#Adding points and setting width of lines in map borders
ggplot(
  spring_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, color = Site, shape = Location_Type)
) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) + coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
  ) +
    geom_path(aes(group = Site), linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Creating Figure 1A copy plot
```{r}
min_lon <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  min()

max_lon <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Longitude) |>
  max()

min_lat <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  min()

max_lat <- autumn_data |>
  pull(Latitude) |>
  max()

ggplot(
  autumn_data,
  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, color = Site, shape = Location_Type)
) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  annotation_borders(linewidth = 0.2) +
  coord_quickmap(
    xlim = c(min_lon - 2, max_lon + 2),
    ylim = c(min_lat - 2, max_lat + 2)
  ) +
  geom_path(aes(group = Site)) +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Autumn Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
```
